oromo: Harki tokko qofti harka hin dhiqatu.
english: One hand alone cannot wash itself.
meaningOm: Tokkummaan fi waliin hojjechuun humna guddaa uuma.
meaningEn: Cooperation and mutual support are essential to accomplish anything meaningful.

english: Those who walk steadily arrive safely home.
meaningOm: Obsaa fi tasgabbiin hojii cimaa milkeessa.
meaningEn: Patience and steady persistence lead to lasting success.

english: Flowing water never grows stagnant.
meaningOm: Sochiin, barumsi fi hojiin itti fufiinsa qabu nama haaromsa.
meaningEn: Continuous learning, action, and movement keep life vibrant and pure.

english: The speech of a wise person is concise.
meaningOm: Ogummaan baay'ina dubbii osoo hin taane qulqullina yaadaatiin mul'ata.
meaningEn: True wisdom is measured by clarity and insight rather than many words.

english: The farmer does not fear the rain.
meaningOm: Namni kaayyoo qabu rakkina bu'aa fidu hin baqatu.
meaningEn: Someone committed to growth welcomes challenges that bring harvest.

oromo: Gaarri gaaraan wal hin argu, namni namaan wal arga.
english: Mountains never meet mountains, but people meet people.
meaningOm: Hariiroo gaarii fi kabaja namaaf qabaachuun yeroo hunda barbaachisaadha.
meaningEn: Treat others with kindness and respect because paths inevitably cross again.

english: What is sown today is harvested tomorrow.
meaningOm: Carraaqqii fi gochi gaariin har'aa bu'aa boruu murteessa.
meaningEn: Your daily habits and effort today shape the future you will reap.

english: Ignoring wise counsel brings regret later.
meaningOm: Muuxannoo fi gorsa maanguddootaa dhaggeeffachuun kufaatii irraa nama oolcha.
meaningEn: Listening to experienced guidance prevents avoidable mistakes.

english: United ants can tie up an elephant.
meaningOm: Namoonni xixiqqoon yoo walii galan wanta guddaa hojjechuu danda'u.
meaningEn: Collective unity overcomes even the most overwhelming obstacles.

english: Education is the light of life.
meaningOm: Beekumsi dukkana wallaalummaa balleessuun karaa haaraa bana.
meaningEn: Knowledge illuminates the path forward and unlocks new possibilities.

oromo: Dhugaan ni qallatti malee hin cittu.
english: Truth may grow thin, but it never snaps.
meaningOm: Dhugaan yeroof yoo dhokatteyyuu dhumarratti ni mooti.
meaningEn: No matter how stretched or challenged, truth always endures.

english: A lie has no summit.
meaningOm: Sobni yeroo dheeraa hin turu, dhugaan ni saaxila.
meaningEn: Falsehood cannot stand forever; truth eventually exposes it.

oromo: Arrabni lafee hin qabu garuu lafee cabsa.
english: The tongue has no bone, yet it breaks bones.
meaningOm: Jechi hamaan miidhaa guddaa geessisa; dubbii of eeggadhu.
meaningEn: Careless or harsh words can wound deeper than physical blows.

english: A tree standing alone breaks easily.
meaningOm: Namni hawaasa irraa adda bahe rakkina keessatti ni laafa.
meaningEn: Isolation leaves a person vulnerable; community gives strength.

english: A long journey begins with a single step.
meaningOm: Hojii guddaa jalqabuuf tarkaanfii xiqqoo har'a fudhachuun ga'aadha.
meaningEn: Big achievements start with small, decisive beginnings.

english: People are medicine for one another.
meaningOm: Gargaarsi fi jaalalli nama gidduu jiru madaa jireenyaa fayyisa.
meaningEn: Human empathy, companionship, and care heal life's hardships.

oromo: Beekaan ni dhaggeeffata, gowwaan ni odeessa.
english: The wise person listens; the fool chatters.
meaningOm: Hubannoon dubbachuu dura callisanii dhaggeeffachuu irraa dhufa.
meaningEn: Wisdom grows through attentive listening rather than endless talking.

english: Patience is the solution to every hardship.
meaningOm: Yeroo rakkoo keessatti obsuun karaa furmaataa agarsiisa.
meaningEn: Steady endurance helps you navigate through any storm.

english: Even when a lion grows old, it remains a lion.
meaningOm: Ulfinni fi jabinni dhugaa umuriin hin badu.
meaningEn: True dignity and inner strength are never lost with age.

english: Death is preferable to a ruined name.
meaningOm: Kabaja fi amanamummaa ofii eeguun wanta hunda caala.
meaningEn: Preserving one's honor and integrity matters above everything else.

english: The one who works will eat.
meaningOm: Jireenya gaarii argachuuf carraaqqiin fi hojiin dirqama.
meaningEn: Diligent labor is the foundation of self-reliance and prosperity.

english: Water flows toward the lowest ground.
meaningOm: Gad of qabuun eebba fi kabaja gara namaatti harkisa.
meaningEn: Humility naturally attracts grace, respect, and harmony.

english: A fire that is underestimated burns down the house.
meaningOm: Rakkina xiqqoo har'a tuffatame boru guddatee miidhaa fida.
meaningEn: Small problems ignored early can grow into major disasters.

oromo: Ija qabuun arguu miti, yaada qabuun hubachuudha.
english: Having eyes is not seeing; having insight is understanding.
meaningOm: Hubannoon gadi fagoon waan mul'atu bira darbee dhugaa arga.
meaningEn: True perception comes from reflection and discernment, not mere sight.

english: A good neighbor is better than a distant relative.
meaningOm: Yeroo rakkinaa namni dhihoo jiru dafee si gargaara.
meaningEn: Those close by who stand with you in need are priceless.

oromo: Quba tokko qofti muka hin qabu.
english: A single finger cannot hold a stick.
meaningOm: Hojii cimaa raawwachuuf tumsa fi walta'iinsi barbaachisaadha.
meaningEn: Tasks that seem impossible alone become manageable together.

english: True words never sink.
meaningOm: Dhugaan yeroof yoo dhiibamteyyuu badduu hin baatu.
meaningEn: Truth rises back to the surface no matter how hard people try to bury it.

english: A pure heart sleeps peacefully.
meaningOm: Yaadni gaariin fi qalbiin nagaa jireenya tasgabbaa'aa kenna.
meaningEn: A clear conscience brings deep inner peace and rest.

oromo: Bishaan daakuu hin beekne lagatti hin seenin.
english: Do not enter a river if you do not know how to swim.
meaningOm: Hojii tokko osoo hin qoratin fi qophii hin godhin hin seenin.
meaningEn: Understand the risks and prepare before taking on a daunting venture.

english: The wind never stays standing still.
meaningOm: Haalli rakkisaan yeroo hunda hin turu, ni darba.
meaningEn: Difficult seasons are temporary; change always arrives.

english: Do not postpone today's work until tomorrow.
meaningOm: Yeroo qabduutti fayyadamuun milkaa'inaaf murteessaadha.
meaningEn: Procrastination steals opportunity; act while the moment is yours.

english: Silence is better than speaking evil.
meaningOm: Dubbiin miidhaa fidu yoo hin jirre callisuun kabaja.
meaningEn: If words cannot build or heal, choosing silence is wiser.

oromo: Simbirri samii keessa barartullee lafatti qubatti.
english: Even a bird flying high in the sky lands on the earth.
meaningOm: Hammamuu ol kaatus madda fi hidda kee hin irraanfatin.
meaningEn: No matter how high you rise, stay grounded and remember your roots.

english: Step only as far as your strength reaches.
meaningOm: Dandeettii fi haala kee beektee karoorfachuun ogummaadha.
meaningEn: Know your limits and grow sustainably without overreaching.

english: Experience is the greatest teacher.
meaningOm: Wanti mudannoon baratan yaada qofa irra caalaa sammuutti hafa.
meaningEn: Lessons lived firsthand leave deeper wisdom than theory alone.

oromo: Abbaa fi ilmi walii galan laga ce'u.
english: When father and son agree, they cross the river.
meaningOm: Walii galteen maatii keessaa rakkina guddaa injifata.
meaningEn: Harmony between generations empowers families to overcome barriers.

english: Bitter truth is better than a sweet lie.
meaningOm: Dhugaan yoo nama dhukkubses furmaata dhugaa fida.
meaningEn: Honesty may sting briefly, but deceit causes lasting harm.

english: The one who sleeps through opportunity does not succeed.
meaningOm: Dammaqinaan hojjechuun bu'aa gaarii argamsiisa.
meaningEn: Alertness and consistent effort are required to reach your goals.

english: Time heals every wound.
meaningOm: Gaddi fi dhukkubbiin har'aa suuta suutaan ni hir'ata.
meaningEn: With patience, even deep sorrows soften and mend.

english: A guest is the blessing of the home.
meaningOm: Simannaan gaariin fi arjummaan aadaa kabajamaa Oromooti.
meaningEn: Welcoming others with generosity enriches both host and guest.

english: A strong person is revealed during hardship.
meaningOm: Qormaanni jabina keessoo nama tokkoo ifatti baasa.
meaningEn: Adversity tests character and reveals true resilience.

english: Beneath the ashes, fire can still be found.
meaningOm: Abdii kutuu hin qabnu; wanti bade deebi'ee ka'uu danda'a.
meaningEn: Never lose hope; sparks of renewal often hide under quiet ashes.

oromo: Dubbii dura yaadi, yaada dura dhaggeeffadhu.
english: Think before speaking, and listen before thinking.
meaningOm: Dubbii gaariin dhaggeeffachuu fi xiinxaluu irraa madda.
meaningEn: Measured words begin with attentive listening and calm reflection.

english: A true friend is worth more than wealth.
meaningOm: Michuun amanamaan qarshii fi qabeenya hin bitamne caala.
meaningEn: Loyal friendship holds a value that material riches cannot match.

english: The person who strives will not starve.
meaningOm: Dadhabbiin fi tattaaffiin yeroo hunda firii argamsiisa.
meaningEn: Persistence in honest effort ensures sustenance and dignity.

english: Truth is the light of day.
meaningOm: Dhugaan karaa qajeelaa mul'isuun shakkii balleessa.
meaningEn: Honesty brings clarity and removes shadows of doubt.

oromo: Mukni suuta guddatu hidda jabaa qaba.
english: A tree that grows slowly develops deep roots.
meaningOm: Milkaa'inni tasgabbiin ijaarame jabaa fi dhaabbataa ta'a.
meaningEn: Steady, unhurried growth creates foundations that withstand storms.

english: Kind speech softens even a hard bone.
meaningOm: Dubbiin laafaa fi kabajaa garaa jabaataa ni laaffisa.
meaningEn: Gentle, respectful words succeed where force fails.

english: Arrogance invites downfall.
meaningOm: Of jajuun nama irraa fageessa, gad of qabuun nama ol kaasa.
meaningEn: Pride blinds judgment, whereas humility keeps one steady.

oromo: Lagi guddaan burqaa xixiqqoo irraa uumama.
english: A mighty river is formed from tiny springs.
meaningOm: Bu'aan guddaan tattaaffii xixiqqoo walitti qabaman irraa dhufa.
meaningEn: Great results are built from small, consistent contributions.

english: Despising the counsel of elders is losing the path.
meaningOm: Ogummaan bara dheeraa keessatti kuufame qajeelfama gaarii kenna.
meaningEn: Disregarding seasoned wisdom leads to unnecessary missteps.

english: Unity is strength; division is weakness.
meaningOm: Waliin dhaabbachuun diina fi rakkina injifata.
meaningEn: Standing together multiplies power; fragmentation drains it.

oromo: Fardi fiigu garaa ofiitiif miti, maqaa ofiitiifi.
english: A racing horse runs not for its belly, but for its name.
meaningOm: Hojii qulqulluu hojjechuun maqaa gaarii fi kabaja namaaf kenna.
meaningEn: Excellence is driven by pride in one's craft and reputation.

english: The scale of truth does not tilt unfairly.
meaningOm: Haqni qajeelaan nama hundaa walqixa ilaala.
meaningEn: True justice weighs every side without favoritism.

english: Preparing for the rain happens during the dry season.
meaningOm: Bara nagaa keessatti bara rakkinaaf qophii gochuun barbaachisaadha.
meaningEn: Foresight and preparation before difficulty make survival easier.

english: True love never grows old.
meaningOm: Jaalalli garaa irraa madde yeroon hin jijjiiramu.
meaningEn: Genuine affection endures across seasons and years.

oromo: Sodaataan osoo hin du'in yeroo kudhan du'a.
english: A coward dies ten times before death arrives.
meaningOm: Sodaa irra ija jabinaan haala mudate simachuu wayya.
meaningEn: Fear multiplies suffering; courage faces each moment once.

oromo: Qeerransi yoo rafu du'e hin se'in.
english: When the leopard sleeps, do not think it is dead.
meaningOm: Callisni nama tasgabbaa'aa dadhabina hin se'in.
meaningEn: Do not mistake quietness or restraint for weakness.

english: Asking about what you do not know is intelligence.
meaningOm: Gaafachuuf hin qaana'in; barumsi gaaffiidhaan jalqaba.
meaningEn: Curiosity and humility to ask questions lead to mastery.

english: The hand that washes cleans the other hand too.
meaningOm: Yeroo nama biraa gargaartu ofiis ni fayyadamta.
meaningEn: Helping others simultaneously strengthens and uplifts yourself.

english: Good preparation is half of success.
meaningOm: Karoorri sirriin hojii cimaa salphisa.
meaningEn: Thoughtful groundwork makes the toughest task achievable.

english: Truth cannot hide in the presence of the sun.
meaningOm: Wanti qulqulluun yeroo isaatti ifatti baha.
meaningEn: What is genuine becomes unmistakable when brought to light.

oromo: Daddafanii galuun hin gahu, tasgabbiin galuudha.
english: Rushing home does not arrive faster than going steadily.
meaningOm: Ariifannaan dogoggora fida; tasgabbiin nageenyaan nama geessa.
meaningEn: Haste creates blunders; steady focus brings you safely there.

english: A kind word is medicine for the soul.
meaningOm: Jajjabeessuun fi dubbiin gaariin abdii nama keessatti uuma.
meaningEn: Encouragement restores spirit and strength in weary hearts.

english: Good character is inner beauty.
meaningOm: Bareedinni alaa yeroon bada, amalli gaariin garuu ni tura.
meaningEn: Outward appearances fade, while virtue remains radiant.

english: Night and day do not look alike.
meaningOm: Jireenyi jijjiirama qaba; dukkana booda ifni ni dhufa.
meaningEn: Life moves in cycles; light always follows darkness.

oromo: Gowwaan waan qabu gatee waan hin qabne barbaada.
english: The fool throws away what he has to chase what he lacks.
meaningOm: Waan harka kee jiru kunuunsuu fi galateeffachuu bari.
meaningEn: Value and protect the blessings already in your hands.

oromo: Mana tokkoon ijaaramu utubaa baay'ee barbaada.
english: One house requires many pillars to stand.
meaningOm: Hawaasni jabaa deeggarsa miseensota hundaa barbaada.
meaningEn: Lasting institutions depend on shared responsibility.

oromo: Abbaan dammaa damma qofa hin eeggatu, kanniisa kunuunsa.
english: The beekeeper does not just wait for honey; he tends the bees.
meaningOm: Bu'aa gaarii argachuuf kunuunsa fi eegumsa itti fufiinsa qabu godhi.
meaningEn: Harvest requires ongoing care, not passive wishing.

english: A lying tongue deceives itself first.
meaningOm: Sobni nama biroo dura amanamummaa ofii balleessa.
meaningEn: Dishonesty erodes one's own credibility and peace of mind.

oromo: Boruun har'a irra caala jettee abdiin hojjedhu.
english: Work with hope, believing tomorrow can surpass today.
meaningOm: Abdiin fi carraaqqiin guyyaa gaarii fida.
meaningEn: Optimism paired with action builds a brighter tomorrow.

oromo: Kabajni namaaf kennitu gara keetti deebi'a.
english: The respect you give to others returns to you.
meaningOm: Akka nama kabajjuutti atis kabaja argatta.
meaningEn: Dignity shown to others creates mutual respect.

oromo: Nama garaa bal'aa rakkini hin cabsu.
english: Hardship does not break a generous heart.
meaningOm: Qalbiin bal'aan rakkina danda'ee darba.
meaningEn: Large-hearted resilience carries people through adversity.

oromo: Roobni gaarii lafa goge jiruu deebisa.
english: Good rain restores life to parched land.
meaningOm: Arjummaan fi gargaarsi yeroo isaa eeggate lubbuu haaromsa.
meaningEn: Timely kindness revives weary spirits like rain on dry soil.

english: A calm mind conquers everything.
meaningOm: Aarii fi ariifannaa dhiisanii tasgabbiin yaaduun furmaata argamsiisa.
meaningEn: Composure under pressure leads to clear, winning decisions.

oromo: Gargar bahuun gaara ijaaruu hin dandeessisu.
english: Division cannot build a mountain.
meaningOm: Walitti dhufeenyi fi wal gargaarsi hojii guddaa ijaara.
meaningEn: Collective effort builds monuments that solo effort cannot.

english: Eating by the sweat of one's brow is honor.
meaningOm: Hojiin qulqulluun kabaja fi bilisummaa namaaf kenna.
meaningEn: Honest labor brings pride and independence.

english: Even if justice is delayed, it is not lost.
meaningOm: Dhugaan yeroo ofii eeggatee mul'ata.
meaningEn: Fairness may take time, yet it remains undefeated.

english: Steady persistence pierces even stone.
meaningOm: Tattaaffiin walitti fufaa waan hin danda'amne fakkaatu injifata.
meaningEn: Consistent effort breaks through the hardest barriers.

oromo: Wal jaalachuu irra caalaa qabeenyi hin jiru.
english: There is no greater wealth than loving one another.
meaningOm: Jaalalli fi nagaa hawaasaa qabeenya addunyaa caala.
meaningEn: Mutual affection and peace surpass every material treasure.

english: A trustworthy person carries the hopes of many.
meaningOm: Amanamummaan utubaa hawaasaa fi hoggansa gaariiti.
meaningEn: Integrity makes a person a reliable pillar for others.

oromo: Baala mukaa qilleensi sochoosa malee hidda hin buqqisu.
english: The wind shakes the leaves, not the deep roots.
meaningOm: Bu'uurri jabaa yoo ta'e rakkini alaa si hin kuffisu.
meaningEn: Surface disturbances cannot topple someone deeply rooted.

oromo: Beekumsi qabeenya namni hatuu hin dandeenye.
english: Knowledge is wealth that no thief can steal.
meaningOm: Wanti barattu yeroo hunda si wajjin jiraata.
meaningEn: What you learn stays with you forever as secure wealth.

oromo: Buna waliin dhuguun yaada walitti fida.
english: Sharing coffee together brings minds together.
meaningOm: Mariin nagaa waliin taa'anii godhamu walii galtee uuma.
meaningEn: Warm fellowship opens hearts and builds consensus.

oromo: Harki hojii bare taa'uu hin jaallatu.
english: A hand accustomed to work dislikes sitting idle.
meaningOm: Amalli hojii cimaa yeroo hunda bu'aa haaraa uuma.
meaningEn: A habit of diligence naturally seeks purposeful contribution.

english: Truth does not fear questioning.
meaningOm: Wanti qulqulluun yoo qoratames caalaatti ifa baha.
meaningEn: Genuine truth withstands scrutiny and grows clearer.

oromo: Ibsaan suuta boba'u halkan guutuu ifa.
english: A lamp that burns steadily lights the whole night.
meaningOm: Humna ofii qusachuu fi itti fufiinsaan hojjechuun bu'aa dheeraa fida.
meaningEn: Pacing yourself sustains you through the longest journeys.

oromo: Garaa laafummaan jabina malee dadhabina miti.
english: Compassion is strength, not weakness.
meaningOm: Namaaf yaaduun fi gargaaruun mallattoo namummaa guutuuti.
meaningEn: Empathy reflects inner security and moral strength.

oromo: Of eeggannoon kufaatii irraa nama oolcha.
english: Caution saves a person from falling.
meaningOm: Tarkaanfii fudhachuu dura ilaaluun miidhaa ittisa.
meaningEn: Mindful prudence prevents needless harm.

english: The morning sun warms the cold water.
meaningOm: Abdiin haaraan yeroo dhiphinaa boqonnaa fida.
meaningEn: New beginnings bring warmth after cold seasons.

english: An alert mind spots opportunity.
meaningOm: Xiyyeeffannoon fi qophiin waan gaarii arguuf nama gargaara.
meaningEn: Preparedness and awareness recognize open doors.

oromo: Ilmaan haadha tokkoo wal hin dhiisan.
english: Children of one mother do not abandon one another.
meaningOm: Obbolummaan yeroo rakkinaa wal bira dhaabbachuun mul'ata.
meaningEn: Kinship means standing loyal when times grow tough.

english: However small your task, do it with honor.
meaningOm: Hojii kamiyyuu qulqullinaan hojjechuun guddinaaf karaa saaqa.
meaningEn: Faithfulness in small duties prepares you for greater trust.

english: False words have no roots.
meaningOm: Wanti soba irratti ijaarame dafee diigama.
meaningEn: Anything built on deceit collapses easily.

english: Sweet fruit waits for its season.
meaningOm: Waan gaarii argachuuf obsaan bilchaachuu eeguun barbaachisaadha.
meaningEn: Good things ripen when given the time they require.

english: Forgiveness unties the knot of hatred.
meaningOm: Dhiifama gochuun nagaa keessoo fi hawaasaa deebisa.
meaningEn: Letting go of resentment frees both hearts to heal.

english: The greatest strength is self-control.
meaningOm: Aarii fi fedhii ofii too'achuun nama jabaa taasisaa.
meaningEn: Mastering one's own impulses is higher than conquering others.

english: A forest is beautiful because of its many trees.
meaningOm: Garaagarummaan fi hedduminni hawaasa miidhagsa.
meaningEn: Diversity and togetherness make communities flourish.

oromo: Dubbii dheeraa caalaa gochi tokko dubbata.
english: One action speaks louder than long speeches.
meaningOm: Waadaa qofa osoo hin taane gochaan agarsiisuun dhugaa mirkaneessa.
meaningEn: Deeds prove commitment far better than promises.

english: Mutual aid lightens a heavy load.
meaningOm: Yeroo ba'aa walitti qooddan hojiin cimaan ni salphata.
meaningEn: Shared burdens feel half as heavy.

oromo: Bara dargaggummaa hojjedhu, bara dullummaa boqodhu.
english: Work in youth so you may rest in old age.
meaningOm: Humna qabduutti sirriitti fayyadamuun boruuf wabii ta'a.
meaningEn: Diligence early in life builds security for later years.

english: Though circumstances shift, truth does not change.
meaningOm: Dhugaan yeroo fi bakka hundatti tokko.
meaningEn: Principles and truth remain constant across changing tides.

oromo: Gaara ol bahuuf suuta tarkaanfachuun barbaachisaadha.
english: Climbing a mountain requires steady pacing.
meaningOm: Galma ol'aanaa bira gahuuf obsaan itti fufuun murteessaadha.
meaningEn: High goals demand measured, persistent effort.

english: Generosity never empties a person's hand.
meaningOm: Qooduun eebba fi jaalala dabalataa fida.
meaningEn: Giving freely enriches the giver as well as the receiver.

english: God watches over the upright heart.
meaningOm: Qajeelummaan jiraachuun eegumsa fi nagaa fida.
meaningEn: Walking in integrity brings quiet confidence and blessing.

oromo: Bishaan qulqulluun burqaa qulqulluu irraa yaa'a.
english: Pure water flows from a clean spring.
meaningOm: Gochi gaariin yaada fi garaa qulqulluu irraa madda.
meaningEn: Good deeds originate from pure intentions.

oromo: Dogoggora darbe irraa barachuun ogummaa har'aati.
english: Learning from past mistakes is today's wisdom.
meaningOm: Kufaatiin darbe boruuf barumsa guddaa ta'a.
meaningEn: Past stumbles become stepping stones when reflected upon.

oromo: Mana walii galtee keessa nagaan jiraata.
english: Peace dwells in a home of agreement.
meaningOm: Wal dhaggeeffachuun nageenya maatii eega.
meaningEn: Mutual understanding keeps harmony alive at home.

oromo: Oromoon taa'ee hin nyaatu, carraaqee nyaata.
english: One earns bread through striving, not sitting idle.
meaningOm: Kabajaan jiraachuuf hojii barbaachisa.
meaningEn: Dignity is sustained by effort and enterprise.

english: Truth is unafraid of examination.
meaningOm: Wanti sirriin qorannoo kamuu ni darba.
meaningEn: Honest facts remain solid under close inspection.

english: The patient one drinks the heifer's milk.
meaningOm: Obsaan eeguun bu'aa guddaa booda dhufu argamsiisa.
meaningEn: Those who wait patiently enjoy rewards that impatience misses.

oromo: Namni nama kabaju ofiis ni kabaja.
english: One who respects others respects oneself.
meaningOm: Kabajni nama biroof kenninu sadarkaa keenya agarsiisa.
meaningEn: Courtesy toward others reflects your own self-respect.

english: A clean heart has nothing to fear.
meaningOm: Namni balleessaa hin qabne tasgabbiin jiraata.
meaningEn: Innocence and honesty walk without anxiety.

oromo: Urjiin halkan dukkanaa keessatti caalaatti ifti.
english: Stars shine brightest in the darkest night.
meaningOm: Yeroo rakkinaa namoonni gaariin caalaatti mul'atu.
meaningEn: Dark times highlight the brilliance of courage and hope.

english: Discernment guards the mouth before words escape.
meaningOm: Of eeggannoon dubbachuun gaabbii ittisa.
meaningEn: Thinking twice prevents words you cannot take back.

oromo: Qonnaan bultoonni wal gargaaranii midhaan haamu.
english: Farmers help one another to bring in the harvest.
meaningOm: Walta'iinsi hojii guddaa yeroo gabaabaatti xumura.
meaningEn: Cooperative effort brings the harvest home in time.

english: The cure for laziness is starting the work.
meaningOm: Yeroo jalqabdu kaka'umsi suutaan dabala.
meaningEn: Action breaks inertia far faster than waiting for motivation.

english: Speaking the truth requires courage.
meaningOm: Haqaaf dhaabbachuun yeroo tokko tokko qormaata qaba.
meaningEn: Standing for honesty takes spine when convenience tempts silence.

oromo: Yeroo muddamaa keessatti obsaa fi yaada qabaadhu.
english: Keep patience and clarity in urgent moments.
meaningOm: Tasgabbiin yeroo rakkinaa dogoggora hambisa.
meaningEn: Calm thinking during crises leads to wiser choices.

english: Peace is greater than every possession.
meaningOm: Bakka nagaan hin jirretti qabeenyi gammachuu hin kennu.
meaningEn: Without peace, wealth cannot bring comfort.

english: Keep your promise, and you will earn respect.
meaningOm: Jecha ofii eeguun amanamummaa ijaara.
meaningEn: Reliability turns words into lasting trust.

oromo: Ji'i dukkana hin sodaatu, suutaan guuta.
